ai.summary: Ram Automation designs and builds industrial control systems in Brea, California: UL 508A listed control panels (build to print or full design, build and commission), custom single-purpose automation machines, IPC/WHMA-A-620 Class 2 and Class 3 wire harnesses, and retrofit and system integration of existing machines. Electrical engineering (AutoCAD Electrical), PLC/HMI/drive software, enclosure machining on a Hoffman Modification Center, and harness building are all done in house; precision CNC machining is done by sister company Ram Aerospace.
keyFacts: UL 508A listed panel shop — panels ship with the UL label applied in house, no field evaluation needed
Wire harness built and inspected to IPC/WHMA-A-620 Class 2 and Class 3
In-house electrical engineers (AutoCAD Electrical) and software engineers (PLC, HMI, VFD/servo)
PLC platforms: Allen-Bradley, Siemens, Omron, Beckhoff, Mitsubishi; networks: EtherCAT, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Modbus TCP/RTU
Legacy migrations: Allen-Bradley PLC-5 and SLC 500, Siemens S5 and S7-300/400, relay logic, analog and DC drives
PLC and HMI source code delivered unlocked, with full AutoCAD drawing packages
Located at 581 Tamarack Ave, Brea, CA 92821 — serving Southern California and nationwide
